summary: Describes a way for a TLS server to resume sessions without keeping per-client state. The server packs the session state into an encrypted ticket and hands it to the client, which presents it later to resume. It obsoletes RFC 4507 and was itself replaced by RFC 8446 and RFC 9846.

eli5.summary: Instead of the shop remembering you, it gives you a sealed note to bring back next time. That saves the shop from keeping files on every customer.

questions: how does tls session resumption work
